provided_split_filename_audit.scope: Existing author train/test directory names only; no new split was created. Filename equality cannot rule out shared scene/tile/nearby observations or model training exposure.
provided_split_filename_audit.stem_normalization: Remove only the final filename extension; retain every source/geographic/numeric prefix, original case, and leading zero. No semantic source regrouping or new split.
provided_split_filename_audit.stem_caveat: Same stem is a same-ID candidate, not verified equal pixel content. Zero stem overlap would still not establish source-scene independence or exclude transformed neighboring images/model training exposure.

examples_to_text_mapping.warning: A .jpg example and .png text reference with the same numeric stem is a mapping candidate, not verified same image bytes or preprocessing.
examples_to_text_mapping.split_count_note: Counts are distinct example images. Within each split, exact and stem-only image categories are mutually exclusive. The same example may appear as a candidate in both splits; these are not held-out guarantees.

limitations: Examples are demonstration pairs, not a verified formal held-out benchmark.
Only 20 example image bytes were downloaded; Text annotations reference many images whose bytes are absent locally.
CSV and JSON are alternate encodings, not two independent sets of annotations.
Annotation inspection does not validate answer correctness, model normal ability, scene-level independence, or pretraining exposure.
No raw files or archive members were modified or extracted; no external author paths were opened.

csv_json_representation_check.note: Observed SARVQA1 JSON prompts may append class choices absent from CSV. Do not infer prompt-text identity from matching counts/image names.
